system.summary: Tokyo (中山) ↔ Shanghai and Yamanaka, April 1916; clear indicator “Sixteenth”. Condenser of the Swatow family: consonants rotated, vowel order e u o i a. Table recovered in October 2026.

prior_solution.where: Not in this repository (pointer only in sunyatsen/y1916); no decipherment on the JACAR copies; Cryptiana checked.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout set the rules and re-read doubtful letters on the scans in blind panels; AI agents transcribed, searched the condenser family, decoded and translated.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Telegrams transcribed from the JACAR PDFs; doubtful letters re-read by Brice Dudout in blind panels.
Search of the condenser family (consonant rotation, vowel order) scored with a Chinese character model; key accepted only if it read telegrams it was not fitted to.
Chinese text punctuated and translated; doubtful codes marked.
Read share recounted with sure codes only (README rule of PR #728) from the status column of decryption.txt: 145 of 168 codes (0.863); 3 of 6 telegrams under 95%; class read -> read in part.
Floor for short texts (README, 19 Nov 2026: under 40 codes, at most 2 holes) applied to the 18 Nov counts: 0592 (27/29) read; class stays read in part.

validation.notes: Chinese plaintext through the telegraph code: the letter n-gram test cannot run on Chinese characters; the readings were checked by sense

outcome.fraction_read_source: Sure codes only (18 Nov 2026): 145 of 168 codes marked ok (or confirmed) in decryption.txt; doubtful and illegible codes are holes; 3 of 6 telegrams under 95%. Before: probable (doubtful) codes counted as read. Floor for short texts (README, 19 Nov 2026): 0592 (27/29) now read; 0616 (32/45), 0629b (31/37) stay under the bar, so the class stays read in part.
